description: Signed key boxes (docs/crypto.md): statement = "kemlock/v1/key-box" || lp(context) || lp(aad) || lp(box) || sealer id (16) || u32be(sealer key version), where context is "space-key" or "collection-key", aad is that box's aad as in sealed-box.json and box is the 1661-byte sealed box of `secret` to the recipient key of `recipient_private_key`; signature = sig1 signature of the sealer's own key under context "key-box" over the statement (3373 bytes). The signature must not verify under a wrong context or over any changed statement. `collection` is null for a space key.
